lifecycle.retention: Keep the configuration read, feature-data sync and destructive rebuild boundaries separate.

value.goal: The proposed unification covers configuration hashes and consistent soft/hard change classification.
value.implementation: Current form hash, required metadata and feature-data sync have separate paths. Known resource class correction can update metadata without refilling a layer.
value.source_verification: The existing hash and class repair source checks apply to their declared fields. The common config classification needs a distinct review of form, schema and style changes.
value.merge: App adopts the class-metadata repair through maplib 64. Delivery of the proposed general config classifier remains open.
value.runtime_verification: Verify offline required metadata and safe behavior for missing or incomplete snapshots when the new scope is authorized.
value.release: Release requires the chosen classifier's own contract and checks.
